observedIssues.resolution: Stopped both duplicate process trees fail-closed; future retry is serialized and must start only after confirming no prior ai-finish process remains.

observedIssues.resolution: Use pgrep with bracketed process patterns for the serialized retry and record the guard limitation.

observedIssues.detail: A previous-turn ai-finish process survived the turn boundary and overlapped the current retry; process inspection showed separate ai-finish parents and pytest children.
observedIssues.resolution: Stopped the stale process tree, retained the current run, and require process-tree cleanup before future turn handoff.
